correctness.rationale: PASS. For p=10n+1>13 and lambda outside {0,1} the five-branch degree-5 Kummer cover has genus six, with explicit holomorphic basis x^(h-1)dx/y^i (i=2,3,4;1<=h<i). Character preservation for p=1 mod 5 reduces Cartier to blocks of sizes 1,2,3. B2 is nonzero lambda^n multiple of Q_n, B3 diagonal with factors lambda^(4n)(1-lambda)^(2n) and (1-lambda)^(2n)Q_n; the height=dimension=3 character p-divisible component is multiplicative, making B4 invertible. The coefficient-ratio/Gauss-Euler transformation is degree-controlled (5n<p), not numerical extrapolation. Nonzero semilinear blocks stay invertible, so stable Cartier rank is 6 or 4 and a-number 0 or 2. Q_n has 3n simple roots away from 0,1 by a regular-singular differential equation of degree 3n<p. Reciprocal roots pair under lambda~lambda^-1, omitting lambda=-1 when n odd and ordinary Fermat special parameters. Derived floor(3n/2) eligible geometric classes; not rational forms or Newton slopes. Independently computed Q_n degree, reciprocity and nonvanishing at 1 for p=31,41,61. Inspected finite checker and coefficient-selection logic; it is corroboration only.

Ohashi Section 3.2, Proposition 3.5 computes superspeciality and isomorphism relations; in p=1 mod5 it excludes the extreme a=6 case, but does not logically determine whether rank is six, four, two or zero on every parameter, let alone the Q_n divisor. The present rank/strata/squarefree/class theorem needs additional Cartier block computations and p-divisible decomposition. General cyclic-cover rank bounds of Elkin and generic p-rank results of Bouw do not supply this exact all-parameter equation.
